analyst.summary: HDFC AMC delivered a solid Q1 FY27 (Rs 837 crore PAT, +12% YoY; AUM of Rs 9.32 lakh crore, +9-13% YoY depending on measure) with its retail SIP franchise still the best in the industry, but core earnings growth has slowed to 10% from 18% last year and the company is losing a little overall market share to faster-growing peers and passive funds. The stock still trades at a premium to peers (~40x earnings) despite this deceleration, and a May-2026 cyber-security breach exposing investor personal data (not fund holdings) remains an unresolved reputational overhang. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely high-quality, well-run business, but not cheap enough, and not growing fast enough right now, to justify adding at current levels.
